terra.problem: “Wrong feast” uses “wrong” to characterize the baker’s answer.
“This was no parade” states a detail about the departure that the passage does not give.
“He clearly wants it to stick” assigns Moses a reason for repeating the instruction that the text does not state.
The explanation repeats that regret is not in the verse without adding much personality or insight.
“Nobody brings tissues to this one” implies no one weeps at the feast. The instruction to rejoice does not establish that.
The blink-and-miss-it joke targets the shortness of the verse, making the way Scripture is written the joke.
Abib is not where Moses started his whole speech. The explanation also implies the Feast of Tabernacles occurs at a different time from Abib, which this passage does not establish.
The explanation restates the verse and ends with a generic observation about a second reason, with little of Papa Dorin’s voice.
